commands.summary: Sets the selection's fill or stroke to the colour at a page point.
commands.title: Pick Colour

commands.summary: Reads the colour a person sees at a point, the mean of a 1, 3 or 5 pixel square; null on empty canvas.
commands.title: Sample Color

commands.summary: Deletes the selected layers.
commands.title: Delete

commands.summary: Duplicates the selected layers.
commands.title: Duplicate

commands.summary: Makes the last undone edit again.
commands.title: Redo

commands.summary: Selects the layers with these ids, the last one primary.
commands.title: Select

commands.summary: Selects every visible, unlocked layer at the selection's level.
commands.title: Select All

commands.summary: Puts back the last edit.
commands.title: Undo

commands.summary: Plans the files an export writes: the format, the scale and the scope.
commands.title: Export…

commands.summary: Opens a new file with one page of the given size holding a frame in its background.
commands.title: New File

commands.summary: Opens a Design file's text in a window that holds no file.
commands.title: Open…

commands.summary: Writes the file and marks it saved; a path becomes where it saves next.
commands.title: Save

commands.summary: Writes the file to a new path and marks it saved there.
commands.title: Save As…

commands.summary: Turns a linear gradient to an angle in degrees about its box's centre.
commands.title: Gradient Angle

commands.summary: Sets the selection's gradient: its type, 2 to 64 stops and a linear fill's angle.
commands.title: Set Gradient

commands.summary: Reads the selection's fill: its type, stops and a linear fill's angle.
commands.title: Read Fill

commands.summary: Adds a stop at an offset in the colour the gradient shows there.
commands.title: Add Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Sets a stop's colour and opacity (a solid's colour at index 0); changes under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Gradient Stop Color

commands.summary: Moves a stop to an offset; moves under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Move Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Removes a stop; a gradient keeps at least two.
commands.title: Remove Gradient Stop

commands.summary: Makes the selection's fill solid, linear or radial.
commands.title: Fill Type

commands.summary: Undoes or redoes until the given number of steps is applied; the jump records no step.
commands.title: Jump in History

commands.summary: Reads the history: the state before the first step, every step's name, how many are applied and which was saved.
commands.title: Read History

commands.summary: Runs Align Bottom on the selected layers.

commands.title: Align Center

commands.summary: Runs Align Left on the selected layers.
commands.title: Align Left

commands.summary: Runs Align Middle on the selected layers.
commands.title: Align Middle

commands.summary: Runs Align Right on the selected layers.
commands.title: Align Right

commands.summary: Runs Align Top on the selected layers.
commands.title: Align Top

commands.summary: Runs Bring Forward on the selected layers.
commands.title: Bring Forward

commands.summary: Runs Bring to Front on the selected layers.
commands.title: Bring to Front

commands.summary: Runs Distribute Horizontally on the selected layers.
commands.title: Distribute Horizontally

commands.summary: Runs Distribute Vertically on the selected layers.
commands.title: Distribute Vertically

commands.summary: Groups the selected layers.

commands.summary: Moves the selected layers 1 pt, or 10 pt when large.
commands.title: Nudge

commands.summary: Runs Send to Back on the selected layers.
commands.title: Send to Back

commands.summary: Ungroups the selected groups.
commands.title: Ungroup

commands.summary: Adds a page and selects it.
commands.title: Add Page

commands.summary: Deletes the selected page.
commands.title: Delete Page

commands.summary: Renames the selected page.
commands.title: Rename Page

commands.summary: Selects a page and clears the layer selection.
commands.title: Select Page

commands.summary: Enters the picked group, so the next click picks inside it.
commands.title: Enter Group

commands.summary: Steps out of the entered group one level and picks it.
commands.title: Exit Group

commands.summary: Picks the layer a click at a point picks: the outermost group in the entered one, or with deep the layer itself.
commands.title: Pick

commands.summary: Draws one shape of the given kind and options in a box, as one undo step.
commands.title: Draw Shape

commands.summary: Gives the selection a 1 pt black stroke with a miter join and a butt cap.
commands.title: Add Stroke

commands.summary: Sets how the stroke's open ends finish: butt, round or square.
commands.title: Stroke Cap

commands.summary: Sets the stroke's colour; changes under one drag token are one undo step.
commands.title: Stroke Color

commands.summary: Dashes the stroke with a preset scaled by its width, or a pattern and phase in points.
commands.title: Stroke Dash

commands.summary: Sets how the stroke's corners meet: miter, round or bevel.
commands.title: Stroke Join

commands.summary: Reads the selection's stroke: colour, width, join, cap, dash and trim; null when it has none.
commands.title: Read Stroke

commands.summary: Removes the selection's stroke.
commands.title: Remove Stroke

commands.summary: Trims the stroke to start and end fractions, turned by an offset in turns; a scrub under one drag token is one undo step.
commands.title: Trim Path

commands.summary: Sets the stroke's width in points, 0 to 1000; a scrub under one drag token is one undo step.
commands.title: Stroke Width

commands.summary: Picks the Text tool.

commands.summary: Reads the selection's box, turn and mirrors.
commands.title: Transform

commands.summary: Turns the selection back to 0 and clears its mirrors.
commands.title: Reset Rotation

commands.summary: Turns the selection clockwise by degrees about its centre.
commands.title: Rotate

commands.summary: Scales the selection about an anchor, the centre by default.
commands.title: Scale

commands.summary: Sets any of the selection's x, y, width, height and turn.
commands.title: Transform
